faqs.question: What are DBS branch operating hours?
faqs.answer: Most DBS branches operate Monday to Friday from 9:30 AM to 4:30 PM, and Saturday from 9:30 AM to 12:30 PM. Closed on Sundays and public holidays.

faqs.question: What are the credit card annual fees?
faqs.answer: DBS Altitude Card: $196.20/year, DBS Woman's World Card: $192.60/year, DBS Yuu Card: $0 (waived permanently).

faqs.question: How do I lock my credit card?
faqs.answer: You can lock your credit card instantly through our chat by saying 'lock my card', via the DBS mobile app, or by calling our hotline at 1800-111-1111.

faqs.question: What is the minimum balance for savings account?
faqs.answer: DBS Multiplier Account requires a minimum of $1,000 to avoid fall-below fees. Basic savings accounts have no minimum balance requirement.

faqs.question: How can I transfer money to another bank?
faqs.answer: Use PayNow for instant transfers, FAST for same-day transfers, or GIRO for scheduled transfers through DBS digibank or our agent.

policies.content: Customers can lock/unlock cards instantly. Locking prevents all transactions but does not cancel recurring payments. Card remains active for unlocking.
Daily transfer limit: $50,000 for online banking, $200,000 for in-branch. Bill payment limit: $9,999 per transaction.

actions.name: lock_card
actions.description: Lock a credit or debit card to prevent unauthorized transactions. Requires card last 4 digits for verification.

actions.name: check_balance
actions.description: Check current account balance for savings, checking, or credit card accounts.

actions.name: transfer_funds
actions.description: Transfer money between own accounts or to external accounts via PayNow or bank transfer.
